verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's docs say its reviews catch security vulnerabilities alongside race conditions and memory leaks (docs-2), and that PR reviews flag runtime errors and logic flaws (docs-22). Pricing lists linters and SAST tool support (docs-29), path instructions can add targeted security checks (docs-8), and a hands-on community report shows a review flagging a critical security risk in a malicious PR (comm-1). Secret detection is documented only in the separately metered AI Deep Scan, which analyzes committed code beyond the diff (docs-5), not in the standard diff review. missing for 10: explicit documentation of injection-risk and insecure-pattern detection in diff reviews, in-diff leaked-secret flagging as part of the standard review, independent accuracy evidence for security findings.
